messages.text: Morning all. Need a second set of eyes on an exception request. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0076}} auto loan, DTI comes in at 47% against our 43% policy cap. Credit is strong though, mid-700s, no lates. Kara, this is one of yours.
Thanks Richard. Is the 47% using the stated income or verified? Client's only been with us since February so I don't have a long deposit history on the checking.

Verified. Two most recent paystubs plus the employer VOE came back clean. Income is stable, same employer for 6 years. The DTI bump is mostly from a new revolving balance on the bureau pull from CreditPull yesterday.
Jumping in as underwriter on this. Exceptions over 3 points on DTI need a documented compensating factor per policy. Richard, can you note LTV and residual income in the file?
Will do. LTV is 82%, residual income after obligations is about $3,900 a month. Also a $2,500 down payment coming from the checking account, already verified.

Unrelated but same pipeline: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0077}} is asking if we can refi the existing loan {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00165}} and roll in a small add-on. Rita, you're RM, right? Does that touch exceptions too?
Yes that's mine. Probably not an exception, the payment history is spotless. I'll pull numbers after lunch and let you know Kathleen.
Back on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0076}}. I'm okay supporting the exception if we cap the term at 60 months and require autopay from the Brightwater checking. Rita, does that work for you as the approver?
60 months plus autopay works for me. Residual income and the 6 years at the employer are solid compensating factors. I'd also want rate priced at the tier below, no relationship discount stacking.
FYI for the exception log, anything approved today goes in the October tab. Wesley's team asked us to include the compensating factors column this quarter, not just the approver.
Got it, no discount stacking. I'll update the memo with the term cap, autopay condition, and pricing tier, then route it to Rita for sign-off.
Memo looks good. Approved with conditions. Richard, please send the conditional commitment through LoanDesk and copy Kara.
Great teamwork everyone. I'll call {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0076}} this afternoon with the decision and walk through the autopay requirement. Martin, thanks for the log reminder, Richard will add the entry.
